Commentary.Commentary: Right! So 176 to chase for Zimbabwe to stay alive in the series. Can they do that? Stay tuned for their reply.

Zimbabwe will be a touch disappointed with the score but if you look at the last 5 overs, just 41 runs were conceded. So that is a tribute to their death bowling, especially with the dew around. Kyle Jarvis was the pick of the bowlers while Sean Williams did his best in the middle overs. Do not forget the efforts of Mutombodzi as well.

After being put in to bat, Liton Das went berserk from the word go. Bangladesh raced to 55 in the Powerplay but once he went, the run rate started to dip. But the brothers-in-law, Mahmudullah and Rahim, staged a good recovery with a 78-run stand for the 4th wicket. Mahmudullah stayed till the final over and ensured that the score crosses 170.

175. Well, on any ground, this should be more than enough. But on this one, with plenty of dew, one cannot say. The average first innings total at this ground in the first innings is 161, so they have got around 14 above par.
FOUR! BOSH! A boundary to end the innings. Jarvis goes short, around off and Saifuddin pummels it through a pull via mid-wicket for a boundary! BANGLADESH END ON 175/7!
Hat-trick ball! Saifuddin pulls it to mid-wicket and gets a couple off this short ball around off.
Aminul Islam comes out to bat on his T20I debut. Saifuddin to face the HAT-TRICK BALL!

OUT! Caught again! Another wicket off a full toss. Would you believe it? All of a sudden, Jarvis is on a hat-trick. Mossaddek heaves it high in the air but gets more height than distance. Simple catch for Regis Chakabva at deep mid-wicket.
Mohammad Saifuddin is the new man in.

OUT! Caught in the deep. Not a no ball. A high full toss, around off, Mahmudullah heaves it over the leg side. It is a simple catch for Sean Williams at deep square leg. But Mahmudullah is not going. He wants the umpires to check whether it is a no ball. He is sharing a few words with Kyle Jarvis who is not impressed. Here come the replays which show that the ball is legal. End of Mahmudullah's innings.

Is that a no ball? Mahmudullah has been caught but he is waiting. Is it over the waist? The umpires are checking. Here come the replays. No overstepping. Also, the ball is below the waist when he plays the shot.
Finally a yorker. Mahmudullah can do nothing but jam it out towards long on. The batsmen cross for a couple.
A low full toss to begin with. Hossain just hits it through the line towards long off. A single taken.

SIX! BOOM! A low full toss, around middle and Mahmudullah takes full toll. He gets underneath it and sends it sailing over deep mid-wicket! 14 from the over and Mpofu finishes with figures of 4-0-42-2.
Outside off, played through point for a single.
Mosaddek Hossain comes out to bat. Just 8 balls left in the innings and he certainly can pack a punch from the very first ball.

OUT! Caught behind! No heroics from Afif tonight. Full and outside off, a touch wide, Hossain looks to drive hard through the line but only manages a thick outside edge. Brendan Taylor dives to his left and snaffles it.
A length ball outside off, pulled to long on for a single.
SIX! This goes off the top edge. A short ball, around middle, Mahmudullah looks to pull but the ball takes the top edge and sails over backward square leg!

Ahhh... that would have been a wide had the batsman stayed his ground. But Mahmudullah walked well across and seeing that, the bowler bowled it well outside off. The former skipper looked to play the reverse sweep but missed. He then looked at the umpire and was disappointed that it was not wided.
Chris Mpofu is back on. 3-0-28-1 so far.
A short one around off, Hossain pulls it through mid-wicket and gets a couple of runs.

JUST SHORT! Jarvis fails to nail another yorker. He dishes out another low full toss. Mahmudullah cannot get under the ball and can only manage to hit it towards mid-wicket. Sean Williams in the deep comes a few steps inside the fence to take the catch. Luckily for the batsman the ball drops just short of the fielder.  Mahmudullah's heart might have come in his mouth. A single taken.

The bowler asks the umpire to wipe the dew on the ball. It is very humid and the fielders are struggling with the conditions. If this is the case now, what will be the scenario come the second? The humidity is 81 percent.
On a length and outside off, Hossain plays it to mid off  for a single.

Jarvis looking to go for the yorker dishes out a low full toss, Afif Hossain looks to go over the off side but fails to get behind the line. He can only manage to get it to deep point and the batsmen cross for a couple.
A bouncer, down the leg side, Afif looks to hook but misses.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Kyle Jarvis is back on. 2-0-17-1 so far.
Full and around middle, Afif initially looks to play the reverse sweep but then adjusts and pushes it towards point for a run.
Comes down the track and works it through the leg side for a run.
Full and outside off, Afif comes down the track and pushes it through mid off for a run.
Afif Hossain walks in at number 6, replacing Rahim. He played a blinder the last time these two teams met.

OUT! That is an excellent catch from Taylor. Full and outside off, Rahim looks to sweep but gets a top edge. The ball goes quickly to Taylor behind who tries to catch it with one hand but cannot hang on. However, he reacts swiftly and then dives to his left to take a stunner. That ends the 78-run stand.
Outside off, Rahim looks to cut but misses.
Landed outside off, dragged towards wide long on for a single. Lost control on that one.
Tinotenda Mutombodzi returns. 2-0-13-0 so far.
On middle, worked through mid on for a run.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for one.
Landed outside off, Mushfiqur looks to play the reverse sweep but misses.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a run.
FOUR! Top edge but safe. Full and in line of the stumps, Mahmudullah looks to play the sweep but the ball takes the top edge and lobs over short fine leg. Races to the boundary.
Full and around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Sean Williams to bowl out. 3-0-18-0 so far.
Length and on the pads, Mahmudullah flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.

DROPPED! Rather a tough chance behind the wicket for Taylor. Mpofu goes short and Rahim looks to pull this one. But the ball takes the glove and goes towards Brendan Taylor who dives towards his left  only to fluff the chance. The ball goes towards short fine leg for a single.

SIX! That is dispatched with disdain. Rahim seeing the fuller one outside off,  brings out the slog sweep quickly and goes up and over the square leg fence. What a sound it made when the ball hit the middle of the bat. Rahim is enjoying it. So does the crowd.
Mahmudullah defends this length ball outside off, off the front foot and into the ground.
Mpofu goes short and Rahim pulls it through mid-wicket for single.
On a fuller one and around middle, Mahmudullah flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Slower one down the leg side. Mahmudullah walks across the stumps and probably that forces Mpofu to bowl one on the leg stump line. But the umpire calls it a wide.
Chris Mpofu comes back on.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
SIX! BLUDGEONED! Full and outside off, Mahmudullah likes it there. Picks the length in a trice and sends it sailing over long off. 50-RUN STAND COMES UP AS WELL!
Another dot. Full and around off, pushed towards the bowler.
Outside off, Mahmudullah changes his stance, becomes a left-hander, attempts the switch hit but after doing all this, misses the ball totally.
The attempted googly, outside off, Rahim drives it through the covers for a single.
Full on middle, flicked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tinotenda Mutombodzi into the attack now.
Mahmudullah works this flatter one on the pads to mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Rahim drives this fuller one straight down to long off for a single.
Flatter one and outside off, Rahim goes for the ball but fails to find the middle of the bat. Luckily the ball goes past the bat.
WIDE! Williams errs in line and sprays one down the leg side. Rahim also misses to lay bat on ball. Umpire calls it a wide.
Flatter one and outside off, Rahim cuts but finds the point fielder to perfection.
Flatter one around off, Mahmudullah works it to mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! Just over the man! Full and around off, Mahmudullah gets down and looks to take him on straightaway. He does not middle it too well and the ball goes high in the sky. Long on gets across to his right, then settles under the ball, only to see it go past his outstretched fingers.
Sean Williams is back on. 2-0-8-0 so far.
Mahmudullah works  this flatter one  to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter one and on off, Rahim looks to paddle it fine but is early into the shot. The ball takes the bottom edge and goes towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! BLAST! Full and around off, Rahim gets down and sweeps it through mid-wicket for a boundary! 100 UP FOR BANGLADESH!
On middle, worked through mid-wicket for a run.

LBW shout but the umpire has spotted the willow. Full and around middle, Rahim looks to play the reverse sweep and is hit on the pads. There is an appeal but the batsman calmly run the single with the ball deflecting towards point. Inside edge involved.
Full and around off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Ainsley Ndlovu returns. 2-0-23-0 so far.
Rahim slaps this good length ball past the bowler to the long on fence for a couple.
Mahmudullah works this length delivery to mid-wicket for a single.
Rahim pulls a shorter one to mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Overpitched and dispatched. Madziva bowls a fuller one and Rahim drives it down the ground past the diving effort of the bowler in his followthrough.  The ball goes to the long off fence for a boundary.
Length and around off, Mahmudullah plays it down to long on for a single.
On a good length and outside off, Rahim opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man for a single.
Another change. Neville Madziva to bowl now.
Fuller one outside off, Mahmudullah looks to cut it but gets an under edge that runs to short third man .
On a fuller length and outside off, Mahmudullah drives it through covers for a couple.
Full and around middle, pushed towards the bowler.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Landed outside off, guided straight to short third man.

Full and outside off, Mahmudullah opens the face of his bat and guides it past short third man. Chris Mpofu gives it a good chase from short third man and gets to the ball. Slips while retrieving but keeps the batsmen to a couple.
Tinotenda Mutombodzi comes on to bowl. A leg-break bowler.
Rahim defends this flatter one around off, back towards the bowler.
Tossed up on middle, Mahmudullah works it to the leg side for a single.
Flatter one around off, Rahim slaps it through covers for a single.
Fuller one around off, Mahmudullah flicks it to mid-wicket for single.
Quicker one around off, Mahmudullah defends it by crouching low.
Flatter one outside off, Mahmudullah opens the face of the bat and runs it down to short third man.
FOUR! BELLIGERENT! Short and around off, stays low, Rahim adjusts well and pulls it all along the carpet through mid-wicket! 13 runs but a wicket as well for the leggie.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Outside off, played straight to point.

SIX! Wow. Just for a moment, we felt that Zimbabwe have got wickets in quick succession. Full and outside off, Mahmudullah comes forward and lofts it through the line to clear long off! Either he does not care that a wicket has just fallen or he has shown Shakib how to play that lofted shot without checking one's shot.
Mahmudullah comes in at number 5 to join his brother-in-law.

OUT! Caught! What a soft dismissal. Tossed up outside off, Shakib probably thinks of chipping it over the bowler. Or, he feels that mid off is up. The ball sticks on the surface and the captain ends up checking his shot. The ball lobs off the bat and lands straight into the hands of Sean Williams at long off! His poor run continues...
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a couple.
Ryan Burl to bowl his leg breaks.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.

MIX-UP, SAFE! Full and around middle, Rahim works it towards short fine leg. He calls for a single and Shakib responds but then Rahim changes his mind. Shakib is halfway down the track and has to change his track. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but Shakib's dive saves him as he comes in the way of the throw and is hit.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and down the leg side, Rahim looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off his pads through fine leg. It is stopped near the fence and three runs are taken, leg byes signalled.
Full and around middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
The fielding restrictions are over and the future captain of Zimbabwe, Sean Williams, comes on to bowl. After this tournament, he will be the captain of the team in their next series in Ireland.
A bouncer to greet Rahim, around middle, the batsman ducks. 6 runs and a wicket from Mpofu's over as Bangladesh end the Powerplay on 55/2.
The pocket-rocket Mushfiqur Rahim comes on next to join Shakib.

OUT! Caught! That is a sensational catch! Take a bow, Neville Madziva. Fuller one on the pads, Das looks to flick it across the line for a maximum but gets a top edge. The ball goes high up in the night sky and towards the fine leg fence. Neville Madziva runs across from short fine leg and holds on to a stunner. He slips across too but makes sure that the ball is held firmly. Bangladesh have been hurt badly here. Liton Das was really going bonkers. Bangladesh have lost both their openers inside the Powerplay.
On a good length and on middle. Shakib flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length and around off, Shakib defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! On a good length and wide outside off, Shakib leans on  and drives it crisply through covers for a boundary.
Length and on middle, Das flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a single. 50 UP for Bangladesh!

Beaten all ends up! A length ball around off, angling away, Shakib walks forward with an attempted heave across the line but fails to make any connection. Oh hello! The replays later on shows that there was a feather of an inside edge. No appeal made. Luck smiling on the Bangla superstar. 8 runs and a wicket from the over, a good one for Zimbabwe!
Skipper Shakib Al Hasan arrives to a huge ovation from the capacity crowd.

OUT! Debutant departs cheaply! The cutter at 114 kph from Jarvis turns out to be too good for Shanto. The line of the delivery is on the leg stump, Najmul tries flicking it off his pads but closes the face of his bat early as the ball arrives slowly after landing. The leading edge is induced and Jarvis runs forward a bit to accept the simplest of catches.
Slower one, on a length around middle at 111.8 kph, Das tickles it past the right side of the mid-wicket fielder for a run.

Das tries to be cheeky there but fails in his attempt. Short in length and around off, Liton moves across the stumps for an attempted paddle shot but fails in execution. With fine leg up, that's not a bad choice.

FOUR! Superbly done. Jarvis delivers it on a length and around middle, Liton hops back to make room and slaps it through the gap at covers for a fantastic boundary. He has rocketed his way to 36 in no time.

Well stopped, Ryan Burl. Saves a run for his side. Fuller length ball on middle and leg, Shanto clips it off his pads to deep backward square leg. It races away and so does Burl to his left from the deep. He dives at the last moment to keep it in. The batsmen run the third run on the throw.
Change of ends for Kyle Jarvis.
Fullish and outside off, it's driven on the up to mid off for a brisk run. 9 from the over, 39 in the last three.
Slower one, on a length around middle at 120.1 kph, Das helps it to the left of Madziva at short fine leg for a run.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Beaten! Slower in pace, on a length and outside off, Najmul pushes inside the line and misses.
FOUR! Not sure Shanto listened to the advice. Short again, wide again, Najmul stands back and slams it over point for a boundary. If it's there to be hit, it should be hit.

Swing and a miss! Called a wide! Plenty of width outside off, Shanto throws his bat at it but fails to make any connection. Liton walks up to his partner and has a quiet word. Maybe, telling him to settle down and leave the hitting part to him.
Mpofu switches to 'round the wicket for the left-hander...
Good length ball around off, Das opens the face of his bat at the last moment and deflects it down to third man for a run.
Chris Mpofu is the first bowling change.
Nicely done. Flatter and on middle, Das punches it down to long on and retains strike with a run. Massive over for Bangladesh, 21 runs off it!
Sensible batting from the debutant. Quietly nudges a delivery on the pads to square leg and hands the strike back to Liton.

Nearly a drag on this time! Ndlovu senses the charge from the batsman and lets out a flatter and shorter ball on off. Das tries powering it on the leg side but  gets an inside edge past the stumps. It's chased down near the fine leg fence and the batsmen take three runs.
SIX! Liton is on fire! Ndlovu under immense pressure. Quicker and fuller ball on middle, Das once again makes room and rifles his shot over long off for a biggie.
FOUR! Das is on the charge! It's probably an arm ball this time, around off, Liton dances down the track and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
SIX! What a shot! Liton is looking in great touch! A flighted delivery in the line of the stumps, Das moves back to make space and powers it over long off for a biggie.
Angling into the batsman, Shanto flicks but finds mid-wicket. 9 from the over, a good one for Bangladesh!
The slip moves out now.
Forces a length ball past the diving short extra cover fielder. By the time, the mid off fielder gets to it, the batsmen switch ends.
FOUR! Shot! Jarvis goes for the slower one and drops it full and outside off, Das picks it in a trice and lofts it superbly over covers for the second boundary of this over.
Another delivery in the region outside off, it's tapped down to point.
Width on offer outside off, Das reaches out for it and drives it with good timing. However, the placement goes wrong and it finds the backward point fielder.
FOUR! Well timed! A length ball on middle and leg, Das picks it off his pads and sweetly times his flick shot to the deep square leg fence.
Kyle Jarvis to operate from the other end.
Fullish and on middle, Liton forces it down through mid on for a run.

IMPACT IS OUTSIDE OFF! A flatter arm ball, landing full and outside off, Das tries to sweep it across the line but fails to make any connection. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Hamilton Masakadza hesitantly goes for the review but to no avail. Review lost in the first over itself for the African minnows.
Review time! The lbw appeal against Das is not upheld. Masakadza has a chat with the keeper and then goes for the DRS. Impact looks to be an issue here.
Das has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Arm ball on middle, skidding down, Das tries to defend it back but fails to middle his shot properly. It rolls back off his pads.
Quicker and fuller on off, driven off the front foot and the extra cover fielder made a good stop to his right.
Starts with a fuller length ball on middle, Shanto eases it down to long on and gets off the mark in T20I cricket.
Time to get underway. Liton Das and Najmul Hossain Shanto (on T20I debut) are the openers for Bangladesh. Ainsley Ndlovu to begin proceedings. Here we go...

Pitch report - It's very humid out there and the conditions will be taxing on the players. As far as the pitch goes, it has a good covering of green grass and the ball will come on nicely to the bat. Some parts have dry grass with a lot of cracks as well. 166 is the average first inning score here. Dew can be a factor later on.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Najmul Hossain Shanto (IN FOR SOUMYA SARKAR), Liton Das, Shakib Al Hasan (C), Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mahmudullah, Mosaddek Hossain, Afif Hossain, Aminul Islam (IN FOR SABBIR RAHMAN), Mohammad Saifuddin, Shafiul Islam (IN FOR TAIJUL ISLAM), Mustafizur Rahman.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Brendan Taylor (WK), Hamilton Masakadza (C), Richmond Mutumbami (IN FOR CRAIG ERVINE), Sean Williams, Tinotenda Mutombodzi, Ryan Burl, Regis Chakabva, Neville Madziva, Kyle Jarvis, Ainsley Ndlovu, Chris Mpofu (IN FOR TENDAI CHATARA).

Bangladesh skipper, Shakib Al Hasan says that batting first will ease off the pressure and they can bat freely without the burden of a target in mind. Emphasizes on batting well and also adds that they have done well in the first two games with the willow. Mentions that they love playing here in Chattogram. Informs about the three changes and tells that they are going in with five proper bowlers. Tells that they don't have any total in mind and want to do well whatever they are doing.

Zimbabwe skipper, Hamilton Masakadza says that he is bowling first as he is not too sure about the dew. Adds that they know that it's a crucial game for them and they will try their best to get those points. Feels that the key is to not lose too many wickets up front. Tells that anything around the 160-run mark will be chaseable as it's a good wicket. Informs about a couple of changes in their playing XI.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it falls in favour of Hamilton Masakadza. ZIMBABWE WILL FIELD!

Hello and welcome everyone for the second leg of the tri-series. Match 4 is going to be played between Bangladesh and Zimbabwe in Chattogram with both teams eyeing crucial points for different reasons. A win for the Bangla Tigers will help them book their place in the final while a win for the Rhodesians will keep their hopes alive and spice up the points table. A lot at stake here. Bangladesh have revamped their squad after the loss against Afghanistan and would like to make a big statement here. Having said that, Zimbabwe ran them close in the series opener and would love to repeat that. Expect a close game. Stay tuned for more...
